rule_filter_parameters.name: ASN
rule_filter_parameters.description: The client IP Autonomous System Number (ASN).

rule_filter_parameters.name: City
rule_filter_parameters.description: The name of the city where the client sending the request is located.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Client Certificate CN
rule_filter_parameters.description: The common name of the client certificate, if one exists. This parameter value is case sensitive.

rule_filter_parameters.name: ClientCertExist
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks whether the request includes an SSL client certificate.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Client ID
rule_filter_parameters.description: The Imperva ID for the client application.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Client IP
rule_filter_parameters.description: The client (source) IP of the current request. You can also enter an IP using CIDR notation.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Client Type
rule_filter_parameters.description: The client application type, such as Browser or SpamBot.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Continent Code
rule_filter_parameters.description: The client (source) IP origin continent.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Country Code
rule_filter_parameters.description: The client (source) IP origin country.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Declared Client Id
rule_filter_parameters.description: The ID of the client application, according to the declaration in the UserAgent HTTP header.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Declared Client Type
rule_filter_parameters.description: Client type based on the client declaration in the UserAgent HTTP header.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Epoch
rule_filter_parameters.description: The UNIX timestamp of the request - the number of microseconds since midnight January 1, 1970.

rule_filter_parameters.name: IP Reputation Risk Level
rule_filter_parameters.description: The risk level posed by this IP, based on the assessment of the Imperva Reputation Intelligence service.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Is Mobile
rule_filter_parameters.description: Distinguishes between requests coming from mobile devices and requests coming from desktop clients based on the user-agent used in the request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Latitude
rule_filter_parameters.description: The approximate latitude coordinates of the client sending the request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Longitude
rule_filter_parameters.description: The approximate longitude coordinates of the client sending the request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Malicious IP List
rule_filter_parameters.description: The client (source) IP address of the request is identified as an anonymous proxy IP or a Tor exit node.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Postal Code
rule_filter_parameters.description: The postal/zip code of the client sending the request. May be available for requests from specific countries.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Source Port
rule_filter_parameters.description: The client's outgoing port number. It can be used, for example, to distinguish users behind NAT.

rule_filter_parameters.name: State
rule_filter_parameters.description: The state, province, or region where the client sending the request is located. The State parameter must be used together with the CountryCode parameter.
rule_filter_parameters.example: CountryCode == US & State == NY for New York in the United States

rule_filter_parameters.name: User Agent
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the User-Agent header in the client request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: API Rate
rule_filter_parameters.description: Measures the rate of API requests in a client session during a one minute period.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Accept
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the Accept HTTP header value.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Accept Charset
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the Accept-Charset HTTP header value.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Accept Encoding
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the Accept-Encoding HTTP header value.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Accept Language
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the Accept-Language HTTP header value.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Connection
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the Connection HTTP header value.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Content Datacenter ID
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the Imperva ID of the destination origin data center for the request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Content Type
rule_filter_parameters.description: The value of the Content-Type HTTP header in the request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Cookie Exists
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the cookie names in the client request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Cookie Value
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the cookie values in the client request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Full-URL
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the full path in the client request, including the query string. The protocol (http:// or https://) is not included in the matching.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Header Exists
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks whether a certain HTTP header exists.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Header Value
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the HTTP header value.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Header Value Length
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks the length of the specified HTTP header.

rule_filter_parameters.name: HTTP Version
rule_filter_parameters.description: The HTTP version of the request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: IP Version
rule_filter_parameters.description: The IP version of the request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: is-HTTPS
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks whether or not the request is HTTPS.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Is Naked Domain
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks if the domain name is a naked domain.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Max Header Size
rule_filter_parameters.description: The size of the largest HTTP header value.

rule_filter_parameters.name: HTTP Method
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the HTTP method.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Num On Session
rule_filter_parameters.description: The index of the current request in the current session.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Param Exists
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the parameter names in the query string and post data in the client request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Param Value
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the parameter values in the query string and post data in the client request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Post Data
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the raw post data in the client request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Post Data Exists
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for post data existence in the request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Post Size
rule_filter_parameters.description: The length of POST body in bytes. If the Content-Length header is present, its value is used.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Query String
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the query string.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Query String Param Exists
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the parameter names in the query string.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Query String Param Value
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the parameter values in the query string.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Referer
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the Referer header in the client request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Request Size
rule_filter_parameters.description: The size of request in bytes, including the URL, query string, and headers.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Resource Type
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the resource type of the request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Scheduler
rule_filter_parameters.description: The times and days for a custom rule to be active. The rule is triggered when requests arrive during the specified times.

rule_filter_parameters.name: SSL Cipher
rule_filter_parameters.description: The cipher suite in the request.

rule_filter_parameters.name: SSL Version
rule_filter_parameters.description: The SSL(TLS) Version.

rule_filter_parameters.name: URL
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the specified string pattern in the path in the client request (without the query string).

rule_filter_parameters.name: ABP Action
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the action taken by Advanced Bot Protection (ABP).

rule_filter_parameters.name: Response Code
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the response code sent by the origin server.

rule_filter_parameters.name: Response Content-Type
rule_filter_parameters.description: Checks for the response Content-Type sent by the origin server.

string_matching_note: Full regex is not supported for string matching. However, you can use ^ for start of string (prefix) and $ for end of string (suffix) patterns within the contains/not-contains operators.
